sentences.text: Laura Robson -LRB- born 21 January 1994 -RRB- is a British tennis player and an Olympic Mixed Doubles silver medalist .	tennis	tennis

She debuted on the International Tennis Federation -LRB- ITF -RRB- junior tour in 2007 , and a year later won the Wimbledon Junior Girls ' Championship at the age of 14 .	International Tennis Federation	International Tennis Federation	Wimbledon	The Championships, Wimbledon

As a junior , she also twice reached the final of the girls ' singles tournament at the Australian Open , in 2009 and 2010 .	2010	2010 Australian Open – Girls' Singles	2009	2009 Australian Open – Girls' Singles
She won her first professional tournament in November 2008 .
